newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts FlightSafety.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman cuts FlightSafety.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said on Wednesday it had cut its recommendation for FlightSafety International Inc to market perform from recommend.
-- Analyst Howard Rubel said he trimmed the rating because Berkshire Hathaway Inc, the holding company controlled by billionaire Warren Buffett, was buying FlightSafety for about $1.5 billion.
-- "Based on the current bid we did not see a lot more upside. If there's a higher bid, then, terrific," he said.
-- The company's stock was unchanged at 49-1/4.
